objections.claim: The proposed credential-separation oracle proves only that credential variables are absent from the agent environment; it does not prove the non-sandboxed agent cannot reach the publisher credential. Because the publisher is described as running in-workflow without a mandatory fresh-runner/job boundary, agent code can leave a background process, writable PATH/tool shim, or other shared-runner state that captures the credential when the publisher subsequently receives it. The stolen contents:write/pull_requests:write credential bypasses the publisher's patch, ref, and execution-surface validation even though branch rules still protect main. A clean checkout does not isolate processes or the toolchain. Require the agents and publisher to run in separate jobs on fresh runners with a schema- and digest-bound artifact handoff and no shared writable state or credential store; add regressions showing lingering-process and toolchain-poison attempts cannot observe or use the publisher token.
